# Pipeline Latency Analysis — oi-tds-prd-eus2p-02

## Summary

End-to-end pipeline latency on `oi-tds-prd-eus2p-02` is elevated (P50 = 5,165 ms, P95 = 7,226 ms) due to **queue polling intervals** in GDS and Streaming stages.

## Root Cause

GDS Queue Wait accounts for 1,886 ms (37%) and Streaming Queue Wait adds 1,590 ms (31%) — together 76% of total latency. Both are caused by conservative polling intervals inherited from a config regression.

## Recommendations

1. Reduce GDS queue polling interval (2s → 500ms)
2. Reduce Streaming queue polling interval (1.5s → 500ms)
3. Reduce TableAggregation batching window (500ms → 200ms)
